arms.mean_W0: m0 for every window (E18's reference, repeated; = mean_s with s = 0)
arms.mean_s: m0 + s for every window (alive: m1; dead: m0): differs from noclip only by g0(x) - m0, and from mean only on dead subcomponents (m0 instead of m1)
arms.noclip: g0(x) + s, not clipped (recruit.added): differs from shared only by the clip
arms.trig, shared, mean: E18's, repeated (the gate reads shared and mean)

measurements.D: R_mean - R_shared, the gap to explain (E18: emoticon 0.19, r1_t534 0.53, r2_t359 0.49)
measurements.R_x: rho_x / rho_trig, rho = recovery (lo - L00) / (L01 - L00) on the held-out windows, as E18's P2
measurements.f: f_clip = (R_noclip - R_shared) / D, f_variation = (R_mean_s - R_noclip) / D, f_dead = (R_mean - R_mean_s) / D; they sum to 1 exactly
measurements.f_variation_W0: R_mean_W0 / D: the part of f_variation that W0's own per-window variation costs with no shift (mean_s - noclip at s = 0); f_variation - f_variation_W0 = how much the variation interacts with s

noise: E18's two seeds agree within 0.02 on R_shared and R_mean; the readings' thresholds sit 0.25 of R from each other on the word tasks

predictions.clip: f_clip >= 0.5: R_noclip >= R_shared + 0.5 D (r1_t534 about >= 0.67, r2_t359 >= 0.87); the filed pattern's construction lowers it, the mechanism reading stands
predictions.dead: f_dead >= 0.5: R_mean_s near R_noclip, R_mean well above
predictions.predicted: variation on both word tasks, medium confidence: a switched-on subcomponent with W0 gates near 1 in some windows and near 0 in others gets s added half-way in the off windows; the clip only acts on windows already near 1. f_clip within +/- 0.2; f_dead within +/- 0.1
predictions.rule: on every task-seed state with D >= 0.3 (the word tasks): the reading is each term with f >= 0.5 (clip, variation, dead); 'split' if none
predictions.variation: f_variation >= 0.5: R_noclip stays near R_shared, R_mean_s near R_mean; the shift added to each window's own W0 gates does worse than the same mean for every window
